items.title: Inference path
items.caption: A short window of proprioceptive sensors passes through a small temporal network with reconstruction, prediction, and traversability heads. Those three outputs become one score. An alert fires when the score crosses a threshold fit on normal validation data.

items.title: Labeled wheel slip
items.caption: Gazebo run. Forward speed falls to about zero while the wheels keep turning. The shaded band is the slip annotation, not the detector output.

items.title: Proxy and measured current
items.caption: Gray is the Gazebo motor-current proxy. Color is current measured on the real platform. The traces are placed on one time axis for shape comparison. They are not a claim that the proxy equals measured amperes, and they are not a lockstep recording of one shared experiment.

items.title: Current distributions
items.caption: Train-set histograms. Measured current sits near zero with a short tail. The Gazebo proxy spreads over a wider range. The two sources do not share the same distribution.

items.title: What lines up with what
items.caption: Pairwise correlations. Measured left and right currents move together. The Gazebo proxies line up with wheel speed and yaw rate, and they do not match the measured current channels.

items.title: Sensing platform
items.caption: Differential-drive platform used to log measured motor current together with wheel speed and position. Callouts mark the sensors on the robot.
